ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Whombat uses the camera to take a photo you attach to a message, and to scan QR codes: the one on your Whombat’s page, the sign-in code on your computer and your Whombat’s claim card.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Whombat uses the microphone for voice typing: what you say goes to your Whombat, which turns it into text.
ios.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Whombat connects straight to your Whombat when you’re on the same network, which is quicker than going over the internet.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Whombat opens your photos only when you attach one to a message.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Whombat saves a picture to your photos only when you choose Save Image.
